# Frontend and API

The internal and public sites are separate React/Vite/TypeScript App Service applications. The API is a .NET 10 isolated Flex Consumption Function. Keep API base URLs configurable, support SPA fallback, return short-lived SAS URLs, and keep internal scores/provenance out of public responses. Crop searches are client-side rectangle or polygon crop submissions for the POC.
